question: How does time sampling/aggregation change 24/48/72h genesis discrimination conditional on a common online 3-hourly disturbance catalog?
detection: positive local vorticity maxima in 3x3 neighborhoods, amplitude >= 1e-5 in file units; online one-to-one nearest assignment with amplitude penalty, 800km gate, no missing steps bridged
representations: completed trailing block means excluding issue time
label: one-to-one nearest online candidate within 800km of first TD/TS/HU record at that time; future genesis labels only, never used for detection or predictors
model: standardized logistic regression, C=1, no class reweighting, fixed feature dimension; no test-set tuning
threshold: validation negative-score 99th percentile, strict greater-than; test false-positive rate reported, not forced to 1%
scope_warning: 3-hourly catalog is common to all feature comparisons, so daily models are conditional on this fine-resolution catalog. This is not an end-to-end independent daily detector. UTC, vorticity units and dataset provenance require confirmation.
